title: cmux NEXT extension samples on the public SDK: each sample's first render

steps.title: Weather: first render (examples/extensions/weather/src/main.ts packed, built only on cmux-extension-sdk, as the customize app)
cmux: clear; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && bun {repo}/cmux-tui/crates/cmux-app-host/tools/pack.ts {repo}/examples/extensions/weather >/dev/null && cp {repo}/examples/extensions/weather/dist/main.js "$D/main.js" && sed -e 's#"local/showcase-[a-z-]*"#"local/customize"#' -e 's#"dist/main.js"#"main.js"#' -e 's#"dist/"#"main.js"#' {repo}/examples/extensions/weather/cmux-app.json > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved weather
